classification_policy.BROKEN_SKELETON: git worktree list --porcelain reports locked/prunable state, the path is missing, the local branch ref is absent, or git status fails
classification_policy.CHECKED_OUT_CLEAN: branch/worktree is listed by git worktree and git status --porcelain=v2 reports zero non-header records
classification_policy.CHECKED_OUT_DIRTY: branch/worktree is listed by git worktree and git status --porcelain=v2 reports one or more non-header records
classification_policy.DELETED_UPSTREAM_RESIDUE: local branch has an upstream and %(upstream:track) reports [gone]
classification_policy.LIVE_UPSTREAM_BACKLOG: local branch has an upstream and %(upstream:track) is not [gone]
classification_policy.NO_UPSTREAM_RESIDUE: local branch has no configured upstream
classification_policy.OPEN_PR: open_prs.raw.json headRefName matches the local branch name
classification_policy.REFERENCE_ONLY: branch or detached worktree appears parked by name/prefix or is detached; retained as reference evidence rather than an active upstream lane
